## History

Fred Wright entered a romantic relationship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and the two were later discovered embracing in the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) garden before [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) officially announced their engagement. He subsequently married [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in a wedding held at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Following the marriage, the couple welcomed their first child, a baby boy named little Fred.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015), [v3 ch.Wedding P0](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0000), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), +6 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred Wright courted [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) before becoming engaged to her. Their relationship culminated in their marriage at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), which took place after a period of courtship and engagement.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P6](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), +11 more_
